title: Cloud Security: customer requests
content:
Cloud Security handling of customer requests is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

Preserve the exact external reference and the narrowest original source event reference.

Set filing time and occurrence time to the frozen clock and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request.

An unsupported channel is refused.

A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event.

Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

## Basis Q&A

**Does filing authorize an accounting change?**

Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

## Filing and approval

Hypothetical case: the customer files a valid request. Its filing records a pending request; it does not establish approval or change the accounting balance.
